reviewItem.question: Does "544aea18c32b34eac523791e7e2ef186abbd6daf: fix(ui): Cannot add an app that has both name and server destination" mean a change to protocol-behavior:argo-cd|name=app-destination-name-and-server|component=ui (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: Argo CD 3.0.0 fixes the UI bug that prevented adding an application whose destination sets both name and server, so such applications can now be added through the UI.
